app_store.name: MotoLap: Moto Racing Live
app_store.subtitle: MotoGP 2026 results & news
app_store.promotional_text: The 2026 season is live. Every practice, qualifying and race as it happens, with standings, rider head-to-heads and the paddock's headlines in one feed.
app_store.description:
Every session of the 2026 season in one place — live results, championship standings that never go stale, and the quickest way to settle who is actually having the better year.

FOLLOW EVERY RACE WEEKEND
• The full 2026 calendar, all 22 rounds
• Practice, qualifying and race results as they land
• Circuit map, length and direction for every track
• A countdown to the next grand prix on the home screen

STANDINGS THAT STAY CURRENT
• Rider and team championships, updated after every session
• Points, wins and recent form at a glance
• Last five results beside every rider, so you can see form, not just totals

HEAD-TO-HEAD
• Put any two riders side by side across the season
• Championship position, points, wins, podiums, top tens, DNFs, poles
• Average qualifying and average race position, where the real gap usually shows

NEWS FROM EVERYWHERE
• Headlines from the paddock's main outlets gathered into one feed
• No jumping between five sites to follow one story

IN YOUR LANGUAGE
English, Czech, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Portuguese (Brazil), Hungarian and Turkish.

—

google_play.short_description: Live MotoGP 2026 results, standings, rider head-to-heads and news in one app.
google_play.full_description:
MotoLap follows the 2026 MotoGP season from first practice to the flag: live race results, championship standings that update after every session, and a head-to-head that settles arguments in one screen.

EVERY RACE WEEKEND
The full 2026 MotoGP calendar, all 22 rounds. Practice, qualifying and race results as they land. A circuit map for every track with its length and direction, and a countdown to the next grand prix waiting on the home screen.

STANDINGS
Rider and team championships, refreshed after every session. Points, wins and recent form at a glance, with the last five results beside every rider so you can read form rather than just totals.

HEAD-TO-HEAD
Put any two riders side by side across the season: championship position, points, wins, podiums, top tens, DNFs, pole positions, average qualifying and average race position — where the real gap between two riders usually shows.

NEWS
Motorcycle racing headlines from the paddock's main outlets gathered into a single feed, so following one story does not mean opening five sites.

IN YOUR LANGUAGE
English, Czech, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Portuguese (Brazil), Hungarian and Turkish.

—

MotoLap is an unofficial app and is not associated in any way with Dorna Sports, S.L. or the MotoGP group of companies. MOTOGP, MOTO2, MOTO3, GRAND PRIX and related marks are trademarks of Dorna Sports, S.L.
